purpose: Choose the measurable bar for the mesh/VU/render phase

arguments.decision: What measurable bar should define progress and completion of the mesh/VU/render reconstruction phase?
arguments.evidence: Owner chose to extend the effort to mesh, VU and render reconstruction; it needs its own measurable bar (completion matrix says it is defined in next-phase.md). Measured: texture-library section of .PS2 models translated from the game's loader and validated on 56/56 files (2370 textures; formats 1/3/4 = 350/1551/469; 1856 level-0 images decoded; next section begins with a count of 0x34-byte records that fits in 56/56). Still untranslated: that record table, later loops in FUN_0011ed90 (including 0x70-byte records with float reads), the geometry/VU consumers. Offline/static only; no emulator oracle; hardware/playback claims never made. Earlier areas were completed under criterion 2: executable check with real-corpus pass, negative/boundary tests, bounded claims, independent oracle where one exists, Jev claim checks, unresolved list.
arguments.priorities: Falsifiable on all 56 real files; claims limited to measured; incremental deliverables; user observations recorded as observations.

candidates.description: Bar in stages: (1) the translated section chain consumes every one of the 56 models exactly to end-of-file with validated counts, negative tests and a pinned result; (2) for each recovered geometry section, extraction with machine-checkable invariants (indices within vertex counts, finite floats, bounding boxes consistent across files, texture indices within the library); (3) a rendered preview of selected models reviewed by the owner, recorded as a user observation, not as proof. Claims stay limited to what each stage measured.
Declare the phase complete when a rendered model looks plausible to the author, without exhaustive file coverage or invariants.
Declare the phase complete only when every game asset type and the VU1 pipeline are reconstructed and the game renders identically.
Stop the mesh phase at the texture library and call mesh reconstruction out of scope.
Ask the project owner to define the bar before continuing.

requirements: The bar must be testable on the real corpus so that it can fail.
The bar must not rely on a person's visual impression as the only evidence for any factual claim.
The bar must be reachable by offline static work without a debugger window or hardware oracle, and must not set an untestable whole-game condition.
